Frequently Asked Questions

Where should I start if my whole apartment feels cluttered?

Start with one 15-minute high-impact zone — like your kitchen junk drawer, under-sink cabinet, or desk cables — so you feel an immediate win before tackling closets.

Why do labels actually help keep spaces organized?

Clear labels remove decision fatigue: everyone in the home knows exactly where items belong, which stops clutter from creeping back.
